still_policy.definition: A still run is the uninterrupted on-screen time of one still image, or of several stills of the same asset_group / near-duplicate pictures, ended only by a distinct shot (different picture, footage, or full-frame plate). Ken Burns, crop changes and overlays do NOT reset it.
still_policy.reuse: A still is shown once per video and never A-B-A (owner rule 2026-11-08). Fix long holds with a NEW distinct shot, never by returning to an earlier picture.
still_policy.min_break_note: A video clip or plate shorter than this does not end a still run (no dummy-card resets).

intensity_scale._comment: shot_scale stretches or shrinks the TARGET shot length for a beat's intensity (1..5). cap_scale only ever TIGHTENS the still caps (never relaxes them). cap_floor per preset stops the tightening from producing caps shorter than a sentence can be illustrated.

slow_reflective.label: Slow and reflective
slow_reflective.use_for: Grief, reckoning, quiet epilogues, memorial / tribute tone, long contemplative chapters.
slow_reflective.transition_style: Hard cuts plus soft 0.5-0.7 s dissolves on shifts; dip to black only for chapter closes.
slow_reflective.sfx_density: sparse: room tone, single soft hits; no whoosh stacks
slow_reflective.music: Thin sustained bed, ducked 2 dB deeper than default under grief beats; no risers.
slow_reflective.grade: Colour script (COLOR_SCRIPT.md): pair with soft, lifted phase looks (contrast <= 0, fade or blacks lift allowed). Direction comes from the story, not from this preset.

documentary_standard.label: Documentary standard
documentary_standard.use_for: Default for narrated historical / biographical essays.
documentary_standard.transition_style: Hard cut by default; 0.5 s dissolve on time jumps; dip to black on chapter change; whip/push only on revelations.
documentary_standard.sfx_density: moderate: one accent per graphic or transition, never two stacked
documentary_standard.music: Bed -24 dB under speech (-28 under soundbites); swells only at chapter turns.
documentary_standard.grade: Colour script (COLOR_SCRIPT.md): one look per phase, 4-8 phases, subtle.

tense_fast.label: Tense, fast-moving
tense_fast.use_for: Hooks, cold opens, escalations, investigation turns, countdown / chase beats.
tense_fast.transition_style: Hard cuts only; one whip pan or punch-in at the peak; no dissolves.
tense_fast.sfx_density: dense but varied: hits on cuts at intensity 4-5, risers into reveals
tense_fast.music: Bed rises toward the beat peak; duck depth unchanged so speech stays clear.
tense_fast.grade: Colour script (COLOR_SCRIPT.md): pair with firmer phase looks (contrast >= 0, saturation <= 0, blacks <= 0). Direction comes from the story, not from this preset.

shorts_vertical.label: Shorts / Reels (9:16)
shorts_vertical.use_for: Vertical derivatives. Every shot is re-cropped for 9:16, never just trimmed (see DERIVATIVES.md).
shorts_vertical.transition_style: Hard cuts, punch-ins; kinetic keyword on every second shot.
shorts_vertical.grade: Same phase looks as the parent video (color_assign.json).

emotions._comment: Beat emotions (core four from the editing tips plus 'neutral' for plain exposition). Rated by the beat-map agent (AI), mapped to parameters by code. No AI writes timecodes.

calm.look_bias: removed 2026-11-09: colour direction comes from color_script.json story_logic, never from the emotion

tension.transition: hard cut; whip only at the peak
tension.music: bed rises 2-4 dB over the beat, low riser into the reveal
tension.sfx: sub hit or tick on key words
tension.look_bias: removed 2026-11-09: colour direction comes from color_script.json story_logic, never from the emotion

grief.transition: slow dissolve; dip to black on release
grief.music: thin sustained pad, duck 2 dB deeper
grief.sfx: silence preferred; single soft hit at most
grief.look_bias: removed 2026-11-09: colour direction comes from color_script.json story_logic, never from the emotion

joy.transition: hard cut; light-leak sweep on a celebratory turn
joy.look_bias: removed 2026-11-09: colour direction comes from color_script.json story_logic, never from the emotion
